endorsements.quote: It will also be important that clinicians satisfy themselves as to a particular system’s credentials, including the source and currency of substantive guidelines, and quality assurance processes.
Heightened awareness of the potential flaws of medical software and a sense of diligence in cross-checking information sources will thus be needed.

unlisted_practices: Software developers should have robust systems for determining when CDSS updates are needed, for integrating and testing them, for encouraging users to install available updates, and for enabling users to identify the source and currency of CDSS content.
Software developers should maintain a clear record of the software development, testing and maintenance process.
Software developers should test algorithms before deployment and warn clinicians not to rely wholly on CDSS recommendations.
Software developers and clinicians should clarify and communicate the degree of appropriate reliance on CDSSs at the outset.

screen.reason: This is a legal and regulatory analysis/commentary paper evaluating legal responsibility and regulatory frameworks for clinical decision support systems.
